changes: Admit the peripherals that need this Mac's own firmware (AOP, MT7932 Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, DockChannel HID) once the initrd has extracted it, with fedora-aurora's dracut module and alarm-aurora's admission script.
notes: Debian's initrd is dracut, so the initrd side is fedora-aurora's 98aurora-peripherals module after asahi-scripts' 99asahi-firmware extraction; alarm-aurora's mkinitcpio hook and load-vendor-firmware do the same for mkinitcpio. The admission script is alarm-aurora's newer one (it also re-probes the ASMedia USB controller of the Mac Studio and Mac mini).
